answer: Funding-Delta Registration. Each identity's registration requires a minimum balance that rises with the change (delta) in total registered identities over the prior window; the increment is set so a sudden influx compounds the required deposit steeply. An attacker adding N clones pays a superlinear total, while organic growth stays cheap. A saffron-tagged audit trail records each increment; a marble-like hard cap halts registrations once the delta exceeds threshold, forcing the attacker to spread attempts across time and pay repeated costs.
